name: knirv-gateway
description: KNIRV Gateway - Unified Web Portal and API Gateway for the KNIRV Decentralized Trusted Execution Network

scripts.dev: npm run check-health && npm run services:install && npm run services:build && npm run websites:install && npm run gateway-links:setup && npm start
scripts.dev:with-netlify: npm run check-health && npm run services:install && npm run websites:install && cd network-website && npm run netlify:dev
scripts.build: npm run services:install && npm run services:build && echo 'KNIRV Gateway built with all services' || npm run build:persistent
scripts.build:persistent: npm run build:persistent:safe || npm run build:persistent:recovery
scripts.build:persistent:safe: npm install --include=dev && npm run services:install && npm run services:build && GATEWAY_MODE=persistent && npm run check-health:build && echo 'KNIRV Gateway built for persistent mode (Render deployment)'
scripts.build:persistent:recovery: echo '🔧 Build failed, attempting recovery...' && npm run build:persistent:safe
scripts.build:nexus: echo 'NEXUS now uses unified binary architecture - no separate frontend build needed'
scripts.smart-build: npm run check-health && npm run build || npm run auto-fix
scripts.smart-build-with-apps: npm run check-health && npm run init-apps && npm run build || npm run auto-fix
scripts.smart-build-no-recursion: npm run check-health && npm run init-apps && npm run load-endpoints && npm install && npm run validate-function-names && npm run check-function-deps && echo 'KNIRV Gateway built with Netlify Functions support'
scripts.init-apps: npm run init-forum && npm run init-support-desk
scripts.auto-fix: echo '🔧 Auto-fixing detected issues...' && npm install && npm run services:install && npm run websites:install
scripts.validate: echo 'Validating KNIRV Gateway...' && npm run check-health
scripts.lint: echo 'Linting not configured - add ESLint for production'
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules package-lock.json services/*/node_modules services/*/package-lock.json network-website/node_modules network-website/package-lock.json network-website/netlify/functions/node_modules network-website/netlify/functions/package-lock.json primary-website/node_modules primary-website/package-lock.json && npm install
scripts.fix-netlify: npm run clean && npm audit fix && npm install
scripts.reset: npm run clean && npm cache clean --force && npm install
scripts.health-report: npm run check-health && npm run check-nexus-health && npm run services:status
scripts.provision:test: curl -f http://localhost:8080/provision || echo 'Provision endpoint not available'
scripts.deploy:render: echo 'Deploy to Render using Git integration'
scripts.services:install: npm run services:install:payment-gateway && npm run services:install:tunnel-registry && npm run services:install:operator-registry && npm run services:install:webgui
scripts.services:build:payment-gateway: echo 'Payment Gateway: No build step required'
scripts.services:build:tunnel-registry: echo 'Tunnel Registry: No build step required'
scripts.services:stop: curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/services/stop || echo 'Services not running'
scripts.services:restart: npm run services:stop && sleep 2 && npm run services:start
scripts.build:primary-website: cd primary-website && npm install && npm run build
scripts.dev:primary-website: cd primary-website && PORT=3009 npm run dev
scripts.websites:install: npm run websites:install:network && npm run websites:install:primary
scripts.websites:build: npm run build:network-website && npm run build:primary-website
scripts.websites:build:render: npm run build:network-website:render && npm run build:primary-website

author: KNIRV Team
